segments.text: To come to the second sort of men and to conclude; let the most zealous Papist that is, trie himselfe and his whole estate with a single heart as in the presence of Gods maiestie, and he shall finde that by his whole religion and profession he doth come short of a reprobate, or at the least not goe beyond him in these points before named. The Lord open their eyes that they may see it.
